summary: mF International Ltd, a foreign private issuer, filed Form 6-K to disclose a change in its certifying accountants. On May 22, 2026, the Audit Committee dismissed Summit Group CPAs, P.C. and appointed Enrome LLP as its new independent registered public accounting firm for the fiscal year ending December 31, 2025. The dismissal and appointment were effective immediately. No disagreements or reportable events occurred during the relevant periods, aside from previously reported material weaknesses. The company provided Summit with a copy of the disclosures and requested a letter to the SEC. This auditor switch is a significant governance event for the issuer.
